summary: Fair page confirms year-round campsites (not event-only), water+electric $15 (30 A) / $20 (50 A), tent $5, dump nearby, fair week $125 via the extension office; fees/hookups/season upgraded to manual. Website moved to yorkcountyfair.com/rentals/campsites/; the RV Life link in website should go. Phone 402-362-5508 confirmed. Site count and how to book a non-fair night not stated. Not waterfront stands (fairgrounds, no water).
